title: Carry bag in greenery
slide_intent: Connect a simple package to its product world so recognition comes from both the signature and its setting.
strategic_value: The white wordmark on kraft can give Sweetgreen’s carry bag a clear identity while the vivid handles echo fresh produce.
demonstration: A kraft paper bag with yellow-green handles and a white sweetgreen wordmark sits amid dense greenery, with small tomatoes nearby.
practical_value: Compare signature scale, handle color and paper material on an otherwise restrained package.

content_islands.name: Bag
content_islands.spec: Keep the broad kraft face and white wordmark visible, with the vivid handles above.

content_islands.name: Plant setting
content_islands.spec: Surround the bag with grasses, leaves and tomatoes while retaining space around its edges.

reference_purposes.Application: The artwork shows the wordmark and vivid handles on a carry bag.
reference_purposes.Expression: Kraft paper and white lettering contrast with yellow-green handles and dense vegetation.
